Sprints 1-3 COMPLETE. Plan: /Users/yashbaldha/.claude/plans/anaystics-page-lets-deep-fizzy-turtle.md

## What's already shipped
- All 6 tabs read URL params (`?from`, `?to`, `?compare`, `?artist`)
- All API routes return `{ current, prior? }` shape
- `lib/analytics/range.ts` (parseRange, priorRange, rangeDays, pickGroupBy)
- `lib/csv-export.ts` (papaparse wrapper)
- `useExportCsv()` hook + `AnalyticsExportProvider`
- `KpiCard` with delta/trend/invertTrend/sparkline/accentVar
- `RechartsAreaChart` + `RechartsBarChart` with `priorData/priorLabel` for dashed prior overlay
- `BookingsHeatmap` + `StatusBreakdownBar` components
- Brand-locked tokens, `formatCurrency` (2-decimal), `formatPercent`, `computeDelta`
- No-show Rust pill rule already applied in ArtistsReportClient (>10% rust filled, else stone outline)

## Sprint 4 Goal
Wire `@tanstack/react-table` for sortable artist leaderboard. Ship per-artist drill-down drawer with revenue trend, top services, no-show timeline. URL deep-link `?artist=<id>`.

## Constraints (mandatory load)
- /Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/InkOS/CLAUDE.md sections 4 (Brand), 5 (UI), 7 (Architecture), 8 (Forbidden), 9 (Antipatterns)
- Brand: ONLY Bone/Onyx/Stone/Rust. Tabular-nums. Custom shadow tokens only.
- No `any`, no `@ts-ignore`, no `console.log` (use lib/logger.ts)
- Zod for input validation
- `@tanstack/react-table@8.21.3` already installed — REUSE
- shadcn `Sheet` primitive at `components/ui/sheet.tsx` — REUSE for drawer (verify it exists; if not, add via shadcn add)

## Tasks (execute in order)

### 1. Extend `app/api/reports/artists/route.ts` — add avg_session_cents
File: `app/api/reports/artists/route.ts`

Each leaderboard row now includes:
```ts
interface ArtistRow {
  artistId: string
  name: string
  sessions: number       // existing
  revenueCents: number   // existing
  avgSessionCents: number // NEW: revenueCents / sessions (0 if sessions=0)
  noShows: number        // existing
  noShowRate: number     // existing
  avgTipPct: number      // existing
}
```

Maintain `{ current, prior? }` shape. Compute averages safely (avoid div-by-zero).

### 2. Build `app/api/reports/artists/[id]/route.ts` (NEW)
Per-artist detail endpoint. Same auth + rate-limit pattern as parent. Zod schema accepts `from`, `to`, `compare`.

Returns:
```ts
interface ArtistDetailResponse {
  current: ArtistDetailBlock
  prior?: ArtistDetailBlock
}
interface ArtistDetailBlock {
  artistId: string
  name: string
  totals: {
    revenueCents: number
    sessions: number
    avgSessionCents: number
    noShows: number
    noShowRate: number
    tipsCents: number
  }
  revenueTimeline: Array<{ period: string; revenueCents: number }>     // grouped by pickGroupBy
  topServices: Array<{ name: string; count: number; revenueCents: number }>
  noShowTimeline: Array<{ period: string; count: number }>
}
```

Filter all queries by artist_id. Use the same date-window pattern (`parseRange`, `Promise.all` for compare). 404 if artist not found or not in studio scope.

### 3. Build `components/reports/ArtistLeaderboardTable.tsx` (NEW)
TanStack Table v8.

Columns (all sortable):
1. Rank (computed from row order, rerank on sort)
2. Name
3. Sessions
4. Revenue (formatCurrency)
5. Avg Session $ (formatCurrency)
6. No-show % (with Rust/Stone pill)
7. Tip % (formatPercent)

Behavior:
- Click column header: toggle asc / desc / none (3-state) on first click cycle. Default sort: revenue desc.
- Sticky header.
- Stone arrow icon next to active sort column.
- Tabular-nums on every number column.
- Row click opens drawer (callback prop `onRowClick(artistId)`).
- Row hover: subtle Stone tint background, Bone otherwise.
- Mobile: keep table but allow horizontal scroll on small breakpoints.

Props:
```ts
interface ArtistLeaderboardTableProps {
  rows: ArtistRow[]
  onRowClick: (artistId: string) => void
}
```

Keep CSV export via `useExportCsv` registration in `ArtistsReportClient`. Rows respect current sort order — pass sorted rows array to `getRows`.

### 4. Build `components/reports/ArtistDrillDownDrawer.tsx` (NEW)
Right-side drawer (Sheet) on desktop, bottom sheet on mobile.

Contents:
- Header: artist name + close button
- KPI strip: Total Revenue, Sessions, Avg Session, No-show rate (4 KpiCards with deltas if compare=on)
- Revenue trend chart (RechartsAreaChart with priorData if compare on)
- Top services table (5 rows max — name, count, revenue)
- No-show timeline (RechartsBarChart small)
- Footer: "View artist profile" link → `/artists/[id]` (existing route)

Behavior:
- Opens when `?artist=<id>` URL param set; closes when removed.
- Open updates URL via `router.replace` (preserves history) — use Next.js `useRouter` + `useSearchParams`.
- ESC closes (Sheet handles natively).
- Mobile: max-height 90vh, drag-to-dismiss handle (Sheet primitive may already support this; if not, add basic touch handler or just rely on standard Sheet close).
- Loading state via Skeleton; error state via DataState pattern.
- React Query key: `['reports', 'artists', artistId, from, to, compare]`.

Props:
```ts
interface ArtistDrillDownDrawerProps {
  artistId: string | null
  onClose: () => void
}
```

If `artistId` is null, return null (drawer stays closed). On mount with valid id, fetch detail.

### 5. Update `components/reports/ArtistsReportClient.tsx`
- Replace existing static table render with `<ArtistLeaderboardTable rows={...} onRowClick={...} />`
- Add `<ArtistDrillDownDrawer artistId={...} onClose={...} />` mounted alongside
- Read `?artist` from search params; pass to drawer
- `onRowClick(id)` updates URL to add `?artist=<id>`; `onClose()` removes it
- Keep CSV registration via `useExportCsv` — pass sorted rows so export reflects current sort

### 6. Verify `components/ui/sheet.tsx` exists
If not, run:
```bash
pnpm dlx shadcn@latest add sheet
```
shadcn Sheet supports side="right" (desktop) and side="bottom" (mobile). Use a CSS-only responsive switch or a media-query hook to pick the side. Recommend: pick `side="right"` always but at small viewports the Sheet visually becomes full-bleed bottom-modal — verify in browser.

### 7. Type guards for the new API
Add types to `lib/types/analytics.ts` (NEW or existing) or inline if simple. Make sure both client and route share the `ArtistDetailBlock` shape — copy-paste OK if no shared lib pattern exists.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Click column header sorts; second click reverses; third click clears (back to default)
- [ ] Active sort indicator visible on header
- [ ] Click row opens drawer with full detail
- [ ] ESC closes drawer
- [ ] URL persists `?artist=<id>` on open; cleared on close
- [ ] Refresh `/reports/artists?from=...&to=...&artist=<id>` opens drawer to that artist with correct date range
- [ ] Mobile (375px): drawer becomes bottom sheet OR full-bleed; charts shrink without overflow
- [ ] Drawer charts respect global date range and compare toggle
- [ ] CSV export reflects current sort order (verify by sorting then exporting)
- [ ] No-show pill: Rust filled when >10%, Stone outline otherwise (already from Sprint 3 — verify still works in TanStack table)
- [ ] Avg Session $ column populated and sortable

## Validation gates (mandatory)
```bash
pnpm typecheck
pnpm lint
pnpm test
```
Skip `pnpm build` — known pre-existing `@anthropic-ai/sdk` failure.

## Report format (caveman OK)
1. Files created (paths)
2. Files modified (paths)
3. Decisions (drawer side strategy, sort tri-state UX, etc.)
4. Validation gate results
5. Follow-ups for Sprint 5 (Clients depth + Bookings/Inventory adds)
